Tess (Marketing Ops): Heads-up: this morning a batch of leads dropped to the fallback owner because enrichment didn't finish before the claim window. Hitting SDR SLA.

Marco (Sales Ops): How many? Any pattern by source?

Tess (Marketing Ops): ~28 leads between 08:50-09:10 PT. Mostly webinar signups with big payloads + a few API partners. HS shows `company_enriched` empty at claim time.

Ivy (Platform): Current claim window is 4s. Enrichment spikes to ~9s under load. We can either increase claim window or do a provisional assign + reassign after enrichment.

Dante (Growth): Provisional assign seems least disruptive to notification flows. Reps see it but we suppress outreach until enrichment finalizes.

Marco (Sales Ops): Agree, but need a clear flag so reps (and SFDC rules) can filter these out. Also avoid duplicate tasks.

Ivy (Platform): Proposed change: soft-assign immediate owner `Holding / Await Enrich`, set HS property `enrich_status=pending`, emit metric `lead.soft_assigned=true`. Wait up to 10s for enrichment; if `company_enriched` then run RR and reassign. Add note on reassign: "Auto-reassigned after enrichment (prev: Holding / Await Enrich)".

Tess (Marketing Ops): Add TTL on soft owner (30m) so we don't leave leads stranded. Also tag metric `soft_assign_ttl=1800`.

Marco (Sales Ops): For SFDC: route `Holding / Await Enrich` to `Unverified Leads` queue and exclude from outreach lists; suppress task creation until final owner. I'll update rules.

lead-sync-bot: canary deploy queued: lead-service -> staging (build #1256).

Ivy (Platform): Canary plan: 400 synthetic leads, 30% large payloads, run at 2:00pm PT. Metrics to capture: `percent_soft_assigned`, `reassign_success_rate`, `avg_time_to_final_owner`, `duplicate_notification_rate`. Goal: duplicate_notifications <3%, reassign_success >90%.

Dante (Growth): Also log sample lead ids for auditing so SDR leads can see a record.

Tess (Marketing Ops): Timeline: staging patch 12:30pm, canary 2:00pm, review 3:00pm, prod at 8:00pm if green. Who owns rollback?

Ivy (Platform): I will own rollback. Rollback steps: disable soft-assign, restore claim window=4000ms, and clear `enrich_status` for temp leads via backfill.

Marco (Sales Ops): I'll notify SDR leads of `Holding / Await Enrich` semantics and share a short search filter for SFDC.

Tess (Marketing Ops): Please post canary dashboard links + sample ids here after run. If anything looks off we abort. Thanks :thumbsup:
